profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that describes itself as a commercial-stage global developer of autonomous driving technology spanning Level 2 to Level 4. Its own site presents the WeRide One universal autonomous driving platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, accumulated real-world operational data, and autonomous driving solutions across the L2 to L4 range. The company says it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi, and describes its business footprint as covering more than 60 cities across 13 countries.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. It states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. The company's SEC filings identify it by Central Index Key 0001867729.

No litigation, no tracked product entries, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
